posts.title: Is modern consumer technology less interesting
posts.description: Recently I saw a post on Hacker News: I used to be excited about new tech, but I rarely am anymore . posts.title: Writing code is a feedback loop
posts.description: It seems traditionally programming is seen as an activity where you make the computer do what you want. You have some requirements for the program, and then you write code to make it do the thing. It’s a linear “one way” process which you repeat until the program works.
